title: The Warehouse with Two Kinds of Empty Space
title_ja: 二種類の空きスペース
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional furniture company leases a warehouse to store products before delivering them to customers.
sentences.ja: 架空の家具会社は商品を配送前に保管する倉庫を借りている。

sentences.en: The manager has been praised for keeping nearly every shelf occupied throughout the year.
sentences.ja: 管理者は年間を通じほぼ全棚を埋めていることで称賛されてきた。

sentences.en: She therefore assumes that any unused space represents an unnecessary expense that the company should attempt to eliminate.
sentences.ja: そこで空きスペースは排除すべき不要な費用と考える。

sentences.en: An employee questions this assumption after noticing that new deliveries are sometimes delayed when the warehouse is completely full.
sentences.ja: 倉庫が満杯のとき新たな入荷が遅れることに気づいた従業員がその前提に疑問を持つ。

sentences.en: The employee distinguishes between space that remains empty because there is insufficient demand and space deliberately reserved for changes in the delivery schedule.
sentences.ja: 需要不足のため空く場所と配送予定の変更に備えて意図的に確保する場所を区別する。

sentences.en: Although both spaces appear identical in a photograph, they serve different economic functions.
sentences.ja: 写真では同一でも異なる経済的機能を果たす。

sentences.en: The second kind allows workers to receive unexpected shipments without having to reorganize the entire building immediately.
sentences.ja: 後者により直ちに建物全体を整理し直さず予定外の荷物を受け取れる。

sentences.en: The manager recognizes that a measurement of occupancy alone cannot distinguish between waste and useful flexibility.
sentences.ja: 占有率だけでは無駄と有用な柔軟性を区別できないと認識する。

sentences.en: The company examines several hypothetical schedules and identifies periods in which incoming and outgoing deliveries might overlap.
sentences.ja: 会社は複数の仮想日程を検討し入荷と出荷が重なる時期を特定する。

sentences.en: It considers the financial cost of reserving space alongside the potential cost of refusing or postponing deliveries.
sentences.ja: 場所確保の費用と入荷拒否や延期の潜在費用を比較する。

sentences.en: Rather than imposing a single occupancy target, the manager proposes adjusting the reserved capacity according to anticipated changes in demand.
sentences.ja: 一律の占有目標を課さず需要変化の予想に応じ予備容量を調整する案を出す。

sentences.en: She also asks employees to document the reasons for unusual delays so that future decisions can reflect actual operational difficulties.
sentences.ja: 実際の運用上の困難を今後の判断に反映できるよう異常な遅れの理由を記録させる。

sentences.en: The approach requires regular communication with suppliers, whose schedules may be affected by circumstances beyond the company's control.
sentences.ja: 会社の制御外の事情に日程が左右され得る供給業者と定期連絡が必要だ。

sentences.en: It does not establish that a particular amount of reserved space would be appropriate for every warehouse.
sentences.ja: 特定量の予備空間が全倉庫に適切とは確定しない。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the exercise encourages the business to examine whether its original performance indicator reflected the purpose of the warehouse.
sentences.ja: それでも当初の業績指標が倉庫の目的を反映したか検討するきっかけになる。

sentences.en: The manager decides to evaluate occupancy together with delivery reliability rather than treating the two outcomes as interchangeable.
sentences.ja: 占有率と配送の信頼性を互換的と扱わず併せて評価することにする。

sentences.en: Businesses sometimes confuse the elimination of visible unused resources with an improvement in overall efficiency.
sentences.ja: 企業は目に見える未使用資源の排除を全体効率の改善と混同する場合がある。

sentences.en: A resource that appears unnecessary under normal conditions may become valuable when circumstances change unexpectedly.
sentences.ja: 通常条件では不要に見える資源も状況が予想外に変わると有用になり得る。

sentences.en: Determining how much flexibility to maintain requires an explicit comparison of its benefits and costs.
sentences.ja: どれだけ柔軟性を維持するかには利点と費用の明確な比較が必要だ。

sentences.en: The challenge is to avoid both unnecessary expenditure and an excessive pursuit of efficiency that makes ordinary disruptions difficult to manage.
sentences.ja: 課題は不要支出と通常の混乱への対応を難しくする過度の効率追求の両方を避けることだ。
